out     — output stem under public/images/; the optimiser writes <out>.webp (max 1920px wide)
and <out>-800.webp, skipping any variant that would upscale the source.
alt     — alt text, taken from the old site's caption and edited to sentence case.
Anything in the manifest but absent here was judged not worth shipping; docs/image-report.md says why.
